DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE & IT,
BHADERWAH CAMPUS
UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU, BHADERWAH
(A+ Grade University- Accredited by NAAC)
Advertisement Notice
Applications are invited from the candidates in the “iHUBDivyasampark, IIT Roorkee.
iHUBDivyasampark, Technology Innovation Hub (A joint initiative of DST Govt. of India and
IIT Roorkee)” funded projects as per the details below.
S.No. Title of the Project Specialization Required Position Required
1. Voice Modification Prototype to
Improve Speech Intelligibility for
Hearing Impaired Users: An
alternative to Hearing Aids
Expertise PLC, SCADA &
DCS. Knowledge of PLC
of Allen Bradley for
hardware development
Project Associate-I
2. A Graphical User Interface for

Simulations, Dimension Reduction
Techniques and Virtual Screening
for Cancer-Targeted Drug Discovery
Expertise in Python and
Script Programming.

Good knowledge of image
segmentation/classification
deep learning models.
Project Associate-I
4. Design and Development of Deep

identify Bacteria species
Expertise in classification
of microbial data using
state of the art deep

Project Associate-I
5. An IoT based smart cow health and
oestrous cycle monitoring system
Experience/ expertise in
handling and analysing
different signals derived
from IoT devices, creation
of dashboard.
Project Associate-I
The positions will be temporary and co-terminus with projects. Interested candidates can apply for
the same on prescribed format and as per details provided on the Website of University of
Jammu(WWW.jammuuniversity.ac.in) and Bhaderwah Campus (www.bhaderwahcampus.in). The
hard copy of the application addressed to the undersigned, should reach at the Department of CS
& IT, Bhaderwah Campus, University of Jammu, Bhaderwah-182222, within 15 days from the
date of publication of this advertisement. The shortlisted candidates shall be communicated separately
via email / mobile regarding the scheduled time and date of interview.
Remuneration per month: i) Rs. 31,000 + HRA as per rules to the candidates
withNET-JRF/NET/SET/SLET/GATE
ii) 25000/- + HRA as per rules for others who do not fall under
(i) above.
Headquarter: Department of Computer Science & IT, Bhaderwah Campus,
University of Jammu, Bhaderwah.
Dr. Jatinder Manhas
(Project Coordinator)
Mobile: 9419173793, 8082770939
Email: manhas.jatinder@gmail.com
